record.paper_title: Invitation to H-systems in higher dimensions: known results, new facts, and related open problems
record.original_question: Let n >= 3, let B^n be the unit ball in R^n, let N be a compact closed Riemannian manifold isometrically embedded in R^m, and let pi be the nearest-point projection from a tubular neighborhood of N onto N. For the n-Dirichlet energy E_n[v] = (1/n) integral over B^n of |grad v|^n dx, call u in W^{1,n}(B^n,N) weakly n-harmonic when d/dt at t=0 of E_n[pi o (u+t phi)] is zero for every phi in W_0^{1,n}(B^n,R^m) intersect L^infty(B^n,R^m). Must every such weakly n-harmonic map u be continuous on B^n?

evidence.quote: In this paper, we discuss two well-known open problems in the regularity theory for nonlinear, conformally invariant elliptic systems in dimensions n ≥ 3

Problem 2.2 (p = n). Are all weakly n-harmonic maps u ∈ W 1,n (B n , N ) continuous?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 3$ and let $B^n$ denote the open unit ball in $\mathbb{R}^n$. Let $N$ be a smooth compact closed Riemannian manifold isometrically embedded in $\mathbb{R}^m$, and let $\pi$ denote the nearest-point projection from a tubular neighborhood of $N$ in $\mathbb{R}^m$ onto $N$. Define the $n$-Dirichlet energy of a map $v \in W^{1,n}(B^n, N)$ by
$$E_n[v] = \frac{1}{n}\int_{B^n} |\nabla v|^n\,dx.$$
A map $u \in W^{1,n}(B^n, N)$ is called weakly $n$-harmonic if
$$\left.\frac{d}{dt}\right|_{t=0} E_n[\pi \circ (u + t\varphi)] = 0$$
for every $\varphi \in W_0^{1,n}(B^n, \mathbb{R}^m) \cap L^\infty(B^n, \mathbb{R}^m)$.

Question: Must every weakly $n$-harmonic map $u \in W^{1,n}(B^n, N)$ be continuous on $B^n$?
artifact.status_search_result: The continuity/regularity of weakly $n$-harmonic maps from $B^n$ into a general compact Riemannian manifold $N$ (the conformally invariant critical case $p=n$) is a well-known open problem. Regularity is known under symmetry assumptions on the target (e.g., spheres or homogeneous spaces, results by Strzelecki, Toro–Wang, Moser, Duzaar–Mingione, and others), but the general case remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Some conformal properties of p-harmonic maps and a regularity theorem
status_evidence.snippet: Regularity results for p-harmonic maps in the critical case p = n, primarily for special target manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Regularity in the critical n-harmonic case is established for special targets, not in general.

status_evidence.title: Regularity of p-harmonic maps from the p-dimensional ball into a sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Regularity is shown when the target is a sphere.
status_evidence.claim: Known regularity results require symmetric target manifolds.

status_evidence.title: A Note on Moving Frames along Sobolev Maps and the Regularity of Weakly Harmonic Maps
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on regularity of weakly harmonic maps; the n-harmonic critical case for general targets is not resolved.
status_evidence.claim: The general continuity question for weakly n-harmonic maps remains an active open problem.
